site.label: Site Buyer
site.title: Your job, today
site.scopeSub: Chennai Metro Package C4 · one job, one warehouse · WH-CHN-03

actions.title: PR returned — needs revision
actions.why: R. Krishnan returned it three days ago: line 2 asks for 12 mm plywood where the approved BBS says 16 mm. Nothing else was queried.
actions.offer: I can correct line 2 to 16 mm, keep the quantity and need-by date as they are, and re-raise it against the same budget head.
actions.done: Re-raised. EIP returned PRC/2026/0041934 and it is back with R. Krishnan — level 1 cleared automatically because only the specification changed.

actions.title: Draft blocked on budget
actions.why: The Steel & Rebar head on this job has ₹42.6 L free against ₹69.0 L of open drafts, so this one cannot submit. Nothing about the draft itself is wrong.
actions.offer: Short-closing PRC/2026/0039660 releases ₹28.2 L — its balance 28 MT is no longer required. That clears this draft without going to Finance.
actions.done: Short-closed through the API. ₹28.2 L is back on the head and PRC/2026/0041866 can now submit.

insights.title: Surplus covers 76% of your open draft
insights.body: 38 MT TMT Bar Fe500D 12mm sits at WH-HYD-01, 42 km by road. A transfer beats a fresh purchase on both landed cost and the need-by date.

insights.title: Near-expiry stock on your job
insights.body: 12 MT OPC 53 Cement at WH-CHN-01 expires in 26 days. The pour schedule can absorb 8 MT if it moves this week.

insights.title: One draft is blocked on budget
insights.body: PRC/2026/0041866 cannot submit. Short-closing a stalled request on the same head releases more than enough to clear it.

insights.title: Indicative rate 4.2% above last purchase
insights.body: TMT Bar Fe500D 16mm quoted at ₹52,400/MT against ₹50,290/MT on 14 Aug. Worth testing at RFQ before award.

insights.title: 3 invited vendors have not quoted
insights.body: RFQ/2026/0009301 closes in two days. Reminders reach the registered email only, so a call may be faster.

cat.label: Category Manager
cat.title: Steel & Rebar, across your jobs
cat.scopeSub: 12 jobs · South cluster · Central purchase group

actions.title: 9 PRs awaiting allocation
actions.why: Nine requests across seven jobs are unallocated in your category. Three have waited more than two days, and two of those sit on jobs with a need-by inside ten days.
actions.offer: I can group them the way they would buy best — four TMT requests into one RFQ at 1.42× volume, the rest routed to the cluster buyers who already hold those jobs.
actions.done: Allocated. Four requests merged into RFQ/2026/0009402 and five routed to cluster buyers, all written to EIP through the API.

actions.title: 2 RFQs close today
actions.why: Both close at 17:00. One has three of five quotes in, the other two of seven — and the second is the 16mm award that blocks two jobs.
actions.offer: I can extend the weaker one by 24 hours and send a final reminder to the four who have opened but not quoted.
actions.done: Extended to tomorrow 17:00 and reminders sent. Both changes are on the RFQ audit trail in EIP.

actions.title: TCC deviation needs your note
actions.sub: L1 not recommended on the 16mm award

actions.title: Rate 4.2% above last purchase on 3 jobs

insights.title: Four requests could buy as one
insights.body: Same category, same window, 1.42× volume and a single freight leg instead of three. One RFQ replaces four.

insights.title: 16mm quoted above benchmark on 3 jobs
insights.body: ₹52,400/MT against a ₹50,290/MT benchmark. The same two vendors are behind all three quotes.

insights.title: One vendor holds 68% of category spend
insights.body: Sunrise Steel Traders is on 9 of 13 live orders. Two empanelled alternatives have not been invited in 90 days.

insights.title: Surplus pool across four jobs
insights.body: 64 MT of rebar idle at three warehouses while four jobs hold open drafts for the same grade.

insights.title: No rate contract covers 12mm rebar
insights.body: MAT-1000482 has run on spot quotes all year. Central finalises steel contracts annually and the next window opens in November.

head.label: SCM Head
head.title: South region · where time and money are going

actions.title: 11 documents stuck beyond 5 days
actions.why: Eleven documents have not moved in five days or more. Seven sit with approvers — five of those with one person, R. Krishnan, who has 11 approvals open.
actions.offer: I can send each approver one consolidated reminder listing only their own overdue items, and flag the two whose need-by dates fall inside a week.
actions.done: Reminders sent to four approvers through the API, itemised per person. The two need-by-critical documents are marked for escalation tomorrow if they have not moved.

actions.title: 3 approvals waiting on you
actions.why: Three requests are in your band. Two have passed the two-day SLA, and one of those is the viaduct pour on LDM02128 with a 15 Sep need-by.
actions.offer: I can walk you through all three here — suggested decision, deviation from the ranking and the reason on record for each.
actions.done: Two approved and one returned with your note. All three are on the EIP workflow trace with you as the approver of record.

actions.title: JCR lapses in 6 days on 2 jobs
Cycle time up 3.1 d in Coimbatore
actions.sub: allocation stage carries all of it

insights.title: ₹38.4 L lapsed in 90 days
insights.body: Opportunities the agents raised that nobody acted on before they expired. Six of nine were near-expiry stock, in two clusters.

insights.title: Approval is 41% of the cycle
insights.body: 9.8 of the 24.8-day PR→PO cycle sits in approval, and 62% of that is one level. A delegation for the ₹50 L–₹2 Cr band would cut it.

insights.title: ₹2.9 Cr locked in stalled requests
insights.body: Fourteen requests older than 30 days with no vendor response. Short-closing them releases the budget inside this quarter.

insights.title: Vendor concentration in two clusters
insights.body: Three vendors carry 71% of awarded value in South, and two categories have a single empanelled supplier.

insights.title: Consolidation left on the table
insights.body: Eleven RFQs in 30 days that could have been four — same category, same window, different jobs.
